project: Dubai Open World PC game - 17 additional roadside store assets
conventions: 1 unit = 1 m, Z up in Blender (Y up in glTF), road-facing front = Blender -Y = glTF/Godot +Z, origin = plot centre at finished ground; LOD nodes <PREFIX>_LOD0/1/2 with visibility-range extras (compatible with prototypes/roadside_lod_post_import.gd), collision *-convcolonly boxes, KHR_lights_punctual night lights (shadows off).
